landing.hero_subtitle: Describe your symptoms and get instant, AI-driven health guidance. Understand when to self-care, visit a doctor, or seek urgent attention.
landing.features_subtitle: Powered by advanced AI to give you reliable health insights
landing.cta_subtitle: Create an account to save your health history and get personalized guidance.
landing.feature_ai_desc: Advanced AI analyzes your symptoms and predicts possible conditions with confidence scores.
landing.feature_triage_desc: Get guidance on whether to self-care, visit a doctor, or seek urgent medical attention.

landing.feature_fast_desc: Get preliminary health guidance in seconds, anytime and anywhere.
landing.feature_specialist_desc: Receive recommendations for the right specialist based on your symptoms.

about.title: About AI Healthcare Chatbot
about.subtitle: An AI-powered health assistant designed to bridge the gap between uncertainty and timely medical action.
about.ai_desc: We use advanced NLP and machine learning models to analyze symptoms and predict possible conditions with confidence scores.
about.privacy_desc: All health data is encrypted at rest and in transit. We follow strict data privacy practices.
about.balance_desc: Our system handles both over-concerned users who may panic and under-concerned users who might ignore serious symptoms.
about.empathy_desc: We combine accurate triage advice with emotional reassurance, making the experience responsible and empathetic.
about.project_info: Project: AI-Powered Smart Health Assistant — CS619 Final Project
